scientific limitations/integrity: The exact orbit formulas are derived from the published reduct classification and switch definitions. Originality is best-of-knowledge after targeted semantic and literature searches, not a proof of global absence. The scope is limited to the five side-preserving closed groups. Computational checks support, but do not replace, the general proof. Independent audit, formal verification, and expert attestation have not been performed.
title: Exact ordered-tuple orbit profiles of the side-preserving random bipartite reducts
